comparison.objective: Pose friction-jointed helping hands so wire ends cross at a mark, versus commission a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Articulated fixture posing and wire-end alignment differ from hex-key insertion, fine collar rotation, torque control, and guarded cycle evaluation.
comparison.success_condition: Requires released wire ends to remain crossed over the target; no shock-response or setting-retention criteria. Numeric alignment tolerances are absent.
comparison.reason: Both adjust hardware, but they test materially different adjustment mechanisms and outcomes.
